title: Twiddledum: dependency chain abuse
description: A Jenkins pipeline builds the Wonderland/twiddledum Node app from Gitea, which depends on Wonderland/twiddledee through a mutable git-tag range (#semver:^1.1.0). With write access to the dependency, push a poisoned higher tag so its code runs in the twiddledum build and exfiltrates the flag6 release token (OWASP CICD-SEC-3, Dependency Chain Abuse).
question: Submit the value of the flag6 release token, exfiltrated through a poisoned twiddledee tag, exactly as recovered.
